title: Reverse-engineer Yoosee Android APK: hostnames and cloud/P2P protocol
description: Pull the Yoosee APK into re/ (gitignored) and decompile with jadx; inspect native libs with Ghidra if the protocol lives there. Goal: server hostnames, how the camera registers and is reached through the cloud, auth/encryption, alarm push. Document findings in docs/protocol.md in our own words, no decompiled code. Interoperability RE on owned hardware only.

title: Local Gwell-compatible server with DNS redirection
description: Using the endpoint map and APK findings: answer the camera cloud hostnames with TianEye via local DNS, and implement enough of the server side (registration, keepalive, time, alarms) that the camera thinks it is online. Verify the camera still streams and raises alarms with real internet blocked.

title: Map camera cloud endpoints from DNS logs and packet captures
description: Put a camera on an isolated network with a logging DNS resolver (dnsmasq/AdGuard) and capture its traffic. List every hostname, IP, port and protocol it uses at boot, idle, live view and alarm, and what happens when each is blocked. Raw pcaps stay in re/ (gitignored); write the redacted summary to docs/cloud-endpoints.md. The block-the-cloud fallback guide comes out of this too.

title: Spike: RTSP to browser live view (go2rtc vs pion WebRTC vs MSE)
description: Pick how camera RTSP reaches the browser: embed go2rtc packages, run go2rtc as a sidecar, or roll WebRTC with pion. Check latency, CPU on a small box, and whether Yoosee H.264/H.265 and audio work. Record the decision with bd decision.

title: Angular app skeleton in web/ with connect-es client
description: ng new with the latest Angular in web/. Wire @connectrpc/connect-web transport, a camera list page, and an ng serve proxy to the Go server. Remove the hashFiles guard on the web steps in CI once this lands.

title: Define v1 protobuf API and buf codegen for Go + TypeScript
description: proto/tianeye/v1: CameraService (list, add, remove, get, stream info) and an event stream (server-streaming only, browsers cannot do client streaming). buf.yaml + buf.gen.yaml generating protoc-gen-go, protoc-gen-connect-go into gen/ and protoc-gen-es into web/src/gen. Add buf lint and a generated-code drift check to CI.

title: Go server skeleton: connect-go handlers, embedded Angular build
description: cmd/tianeye: HTTP server with h2c, mounts the generated Connect handlers, serves web/dist via go:embed. Camera list and credentials live in a gitignored local config file. Remove the hashFiles guard on the Go steps in CI once this lands.

title: Inventory test cameras: model, firmware, open ports, RTSP/ONVIF
description: For each Yoosee camera on hand: record model, firmware version, nmap -p- port list, and whether rtsp onvif1/onvif2 and ONVIF on 5000 work (ffprobe). Add results to the README Tested cameras table using placeholder IPs, never real ones.

title: Recording to local disk with retention
description: Continuous segmented recording per camera (no re-encode), size/age-based retention, playback list in the UI. Motion-triggered recording is a follow-up.

title: LAN discovery of Yoosee cameras (ONVIF WS-Discovery)
description: Find cameras on the LAN via ONVIF WS-Discovery, then fall back to probing port 554/5000 on a user-given subnet. Capture any Yoosee-specific broadcast seen during the inventory.

title: Research: cloud-free provisioning of factory-reset cameras
description: Deferred until streams work. Reverse-engineer the Gwell setup flow (AP mode, sound-wave pairing, P2P ports) so a reset camera can join Wi-Fi and get a password without the Yoosee app.
